intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra is reading a maintenance report bound in red leather. It has a ribbon bookmark.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Four meetings to decide whether a loose stair is an emergency.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “That it is ‘a matter of ongoing concern.’ There is an appendix.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Two members have since tripped on it. They have requested a fifth meeting.”

options.labelText: “Skip the fifth meeting. Who has a hammer?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “The carpenters. They have been waiting since the second meeting.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I will tell them the committee approved it. The committee can find out afterward.”

options.labelText: “Can we take a moment to admire the binding?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “The binding is excellent. I will read it aloud to the stair.”
